description: This file contains utility functions for parsing and handling frontmatter metadata, including JSON5 parsing, string normalization, and manifest requirement resolution, specific to the openclaw project.

methods.name: normalizeStringList
methods.description: Converts input into a string array, splitting by comma if input is a string, trimming whitespace, and filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: getFrontmatterString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from frontmatter by key if it exists and is a string.

methods.name: parseFrontmatterBool
methods.description: Parses a string value into a boolean, with fallback if parsing fails.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestBlock
methods.description: Extracts a manifest block from frontmatter using JSON5 parsing, checking for specific manifest keys.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestRequires
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the requirements section of a manifest, including bins, env, and config.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestInstall
methods.description: Resolves an array of install specifications from manifest metadata.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestOs
methods.description: Normalizes the 'os' field from manifest metadata into a string array.

methods.name: parseOpenClawManifestInstallBase
methods.description: Parses and validates a manifest install base object, ensuring the kind is allowed.

methods.name: applyOpenClawManifestInstallCommonFields
methods.description: Applies common fields (id, label, bins) to a manifest install spec.
